description: Exact U.S. federal holidays for any year 1971-2100 under 5 U.S.C. 6103: legal date, OPM observed date (Saturday -> Friday, Sunday -> Monday, so New Year's Day 2022 is observed Friday 2021-12-31) and the Federal Reserve closure date (Fed Banks stay OPEN the Friday before a Saturday holiday). Applies the rule history a model tends to get wrong: Juneteenth from 2021, MLK Day from 1986, Veterans Day on the 4th Monday of October 1971-1977, and Inauguration Day (DC area only, flagged optional). No network calls.
name: list_federal_holidays
title: List U.S. federal holidays for a year
